name: @six5536/agent-harness-kit-workspace
description: agent-harness-kit: npm packages for the ahk CLI.

scripts.build:linux-x64: rustup target add x86_64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl -p agent-harness-kit && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/release/ahk packages/agent-harness-kit-linux-x64/bin/ahk
scripts.build:linux-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-unknown-linux-musl && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-unknown-linux-musl -p agent-harness-kit && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-unknown-linux-musl/release/ahk packages/agent-harness-kit-linux-arm64/bin/ahk
scripts.build:darwin-x64: rustup target add x86_64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin -p agent-harness-kit && install -m 0755 target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/ahk packages/agent-harness-kit-darwin-x64/bin/ahk
scripts.build:darwin-arm64: rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin && mise exec -- cargo zigbuild --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin -p agent-harness-kit && install -m 0755 target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/ahk packages/agent-harness-kit-darwin-arm64/bin/ahk
